name: App
responsibility: Application lifecycle, window and menu wiring, station composition
may import: Session, Player, Engine (PlayerBackend only), Media, UI, Platform

name: Player
responsibility: Playback control surface: PlayerController, PlayerView, Input

name: Engine
responsibility: Engine selection and backends; the only station that talks to an engine

name: Media
responsibility: Media inventory, sources, file browser, torrent endpoints

name: Picture
responsibility: Picture pipeline policy: color, filters, presentation preferences

name: Stereo
responsibility: Stereoscopic playback policy and metadata presentation

name: Camera
responsibility: Camera capture, preview and device policy

name: Subtitles
responsibility: Subtitle tracks, parsing policy and presentation

name: UI
responsibility: Shared UI components, menu actions and helpers

name: Session
responsibility: Playback session context, resources, diagnostics and log transport
